text:
GTA VI PC Recomp

 Runtime shader recompilation and performance optimization framework for Grand Theft Auto VI (PC)

 
 
 
 

 Overview

GTA VI PC Recomp is an experimental runtime optimization framework focused on reducing shader compilation stutter, improving asset streaming responsiveness, and enhancing frame pacing consistency in Grand Theft Auto VI for PC.

The project provides dynamic shader cache generation, multi-threaded asset preparation, and render pipeline optimizations designed to improve gameplay smoothness across a wide range of hardware configurations.

 Features

 Rendering Optimizations

- Runtime shader cache generation
- Dynamic PSO (Pipeline State Object) management
- Multi-threaded shader preloading
- Reduced DX12 shader compilation stutter
- Improved render pipeline responsiveness

 CPU Optimization

- Dynamic thread management
- Hybrid-core scheduling support
- Background task balancing
- Reduced main-thread bottlenecks

 Memory & Streaming

- Optimized texture streaming
- Improved asset loading prioritization
- Dynamic decompression scheduling
- Reduced world streaming hitching

 Upscaling & Frame Generation

Compatible with:

- NVIDIA DLSS
- AMD FSR
- Intel XeSS

 System Requirements

 Minimum

 Component Requirement 
 ------------ ------------- 
 CPU Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel i5-12400 
 RAM 16 GB 
 GPU RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT 
 Storage SSD 
 OS Windows 10 22H2 

 Recommended

 Component Requirement 
 ------------ ------------- 
 CPU Ryzen 7 7800X3D / Intel i7-14700K 
 RAM 32 GB 
 GPU RTX 4080 / RX 7900 XTX 
 Storage NVMe SSD 
 OS Windows 11 24H2 

 Benchmark Results

 Configuration Native FPS Optimized FPS 
 --------------- ------------ --------------- 
 RTX 3060 58 71 
 RTX 4070 87 104 
 RTX 4080 116 138 
 RX 7900 XTX 122 145 

 Internal benchmark performed using a dense urban environment with maximum traffic and pedestrian density. 

 Installation

1. Extract the archive into the GTA VI installation directory.
2. Run Setup.exe .
3. Launch the game.
4. Shader cache generation will occur automatically during the first launch.
5. Performance logs can be found inside the logs directory.

 Directory Structure

 

 Configuration

 

 Known Issues

- First launch may require additional time to build the shader cache.
- Some third-party overlays may interfere with performance monitoring.
- Ultra-wide resolutions above 32:9 are considered experimental.

 Roadmap

- Additional shader cache optimizations
- Improved CPU scheduling logic
- Enhanced asset streaming system
- Expanded graphics API support
- Advanced telemetry and diagnostics
